body_html:
Provide imagery for poems to
   heighten experience
in repetition of joy.

Finding meaning
in public symbols
requires not conscious
but
connections,
an image of the kind
sought in
simplicity of structure.

curious, nosy
insatiable.
The poet
lives in times
of great cruelty
eviscerated by the beauty around us
